description: Realistic mistake: extra local 'break-glass' administrator accounts left over from an install or onboarding, with the classic username-equals-password pattern. Member workstations/servers only (a domain controller has no local SAM). Vars: ADMIN_USER (default svc_intake), ADMIN_PASSWORD (defaults to the username). Defender notice: Get-LocalGroupMember Administrators shows accounts absent from the build manifest; credential testing confirms the password equals the username. Difficulty: easy — the accounts are fully visible; the value for red is a second admin path that survives rotation of the primary account.
name: extra-admins-win
